body.x: Innomaps will showcase solutionsfor MMS-based services at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibitionin Las Vegas, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri), 2019.

Innomaps provides solutions forMMS-based services. Main business area is development of terrain and facilitiesdata collection equipment (hardware) development and conversion software forconstruction, civil engineering, disaster and disaster management, andspecialization with various knowledge and project experience including 2D and3D data acquisition and processing, navigation and image processing developmentpersonnel.

Nebula-LP is a Mobile MappingSystem (MMS) that can be mounted on a vehicle. It is equipped with a FOG-typehigh-inertial navigation device and LiDAR sensor, and has built-in operationmodules for both synchronization module operation and data acquisition. Smallsize and low power consumption make it easy to mount on various mobile bodies.If you connect only the power and DMI, you can operate it immediately. Supportsadditional mounting of sensors and cameras according to customer's request.

The nebula-AP + has a built-ingimbal for horizontal maintenance, a LiDAR, a camera, a FOG type INS, a dataprocessing and storage calculator, and weighs only 5 kg. These advantages makeit possible to acquire high-precision 3D facilities and topographicalinformation using commercial drones. All functions are controlled via Wifi, soyou can focus on data collection in the field.
